lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Five to six identifiable horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle, with highest spatial density observed in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Narrow vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, creating a distinct grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible along the upper and mid-lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal aspect and shadow on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette is primarily filled with high-luminance vertical and diagonal linear fragments rather than discrete circular spots, concentrated more heavily toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch/irregularity is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; minor irregular fraying observed on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible attached to or trailing the ventral surface, specifically clustered posterior to the pectoral fin.
